Ensure seamless and dependable power transitions with this Eaton 1200A, 4-Pole, Open Transition Automatic Transfer Switch. Built for efficiency and reliability, this unit is well-suited for commercial and industrial power systems requiring safe and continuous operation.
Key Features
Amperage: 1200A
Configuration: 4-Pole, Open Transition
Enclosure: NEMA 3R / service entrance, front-accessible design
Standards: UL 1008 certified

Raw Amethyst Decorative Specimen
Purple Crystal Cluster on Clear Glass Base
Vintage Style, 8 Inches Tall
This striking decorative piece features a natural raw amethyst cluster securely mounted atop a solid clear glass block. The specimen showcases a dense concentration of crystalline points with a rich spectrum of violet and deep purple hues. The minimalist glass base provides a modern, elevated presentation that highlights the organic textures and geometric forms of the natural mineral formation.
Natural amethyst cluster with varied crystalline terminations and deep purple color density
Securely mounted on a heavy, polished clear glass cube base
Visible natural stone matrix on the reverse side showing authentic geological origins
Overall dimensions: 8" height with a 3" x 3" square base
Condition:
The amethyst cluster is in its natural raw state with inherent crystalline irregularities and matrix textures. The glass block base is structurally sound and clear, though it shows minor signs of previous display such as light surface scratches and adhesive residue from former protective pads on the underside. The specimen is firmly attached to the base.
